videos.caption: day 68: cut test after $200 why this test failed: 1. not enough low-scale comp (besides the direct comp I swiped test ads from) my last test that got 18 sales has 2-3+ bigger stores and a lot of smaller comp, myself included  not to say this prod couldn’t work, but less comp means it’s less validated/riskier, albeit high reward if it worked going forward, I’ll sell to markets with more low-scale comp  2. assets need to be 100% done before launch no editing the pdp after ads go live  this is to eliminate questions/variables when assessing ad performance  I don’t want to ask, “are my results bad bc my ads are shit or bc my pdp doesn’t have enough social proof?” moving onto the next  #higherupwellnesschallenge #unignorable30 #ecommercetips #aidropshipping #fbads
